reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "tools/lambda-promtail: Do not evaluate empty string for drop_labels (#11074) (94169a0)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Empty strings in drop_labels configuration are no longer evaluated, which corrects the handling of this configuration parameter in lambda-promtail.

proposed.statement: The lambda-promtail tool no longer evaluates empty strings when processing drop_labels configuration.
